description: A painted night scene of a shirtless, thin man with a loincloth, tied to a stake and standing in a tall column of flames with smoke rising behind him. On the left, an elderly white-bearded man in a black robe holds an open book, and a crowd in dark period clothing stands on both sides, one man sitting on the right. Faggots are piled at the base of the fire, with dark buildings and a night sky behind. The painting has a thin white border on all four sides, like a mat, and there is a small mark at the bottom right corner.
reason: the painting sits inside a thin white mat or border on all four sides; it should fill the image edge to edge.
